name: Zalaboldogfa (Hungary)
description: White field with a row of red triangles pointing from the hoist edge and a row of green triangles pointing from the fly edge, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Zalaboldogfa: a crowned quartered green, red and yellow shield with a tree, bars and a lion, above a scroll inscribed ZALABOLDOGFA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Zalaboldogfa arms with crown and scroll
